1.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
1.summary: Universities have been accused of doctoring photos to showcase diversity in the past. In this case, a Black woman replaced a Hispanic young man, who said it was upsetting to be “erased.”

2.title: Trump tells UN he has 'big decision' on whether to 'annihilate' Iran or make peace deal
2.summary: Members of Iran's delegation walked out during the president's speech in New York.

3.title: An Army of Paid Creators Is Carpeting the Web With Political Content
3.summary: Unlike celebrity influencers with large followings, these creators produce a blizzard of videos for a fraction of the cost of traditional online campaigns and, in the process, shift public conversation.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Trump Says He Faces Choice to Make a Deal or ‘Annihilate’ Iran
4.summary: President Trump delivered the remark before a gathering where world leaders typically present themselves as champions of global harmony. Earlier, António Guterres, the U.N. secretary general, called on leaders to end conflicts.

5.title: Shooting Near High School in Turkey Injures 11
5.summary: The attack came months after back-to-back school shootings in the country, where educators have been warning about rising violence.

6.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
6.summary: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.
